scoring_justification: Recomputing DFT NEB barriers in the checker sandbox is infeasible, so we compare the agent's reported barriers to the paper's values with tolerances and check self-consistency of derived ratios.

hidden_assets.purpose: paper-reported activation barriers and derived selectivity ratios
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from the paper: CH3O->CH3OH 0.15 eV, CH3O->CH4 1.21 eV, CO->CHO 0.39 eV, CO->COH 0.21 eV; selectivity ratio ~6e17, COH/CHO ~2000.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values taken directly from the paper's conclusions and results sections.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual measured and reported values from the published paper.

outputs.description: Activation barriers (eV) at U = -1.15 V (RHE) for the four selectivity-determining elementary steps plus the ethylene C2H4 formation barrier from CH2 dimerization.
Selectivity ratios and barrier differences derived from activation barriers.

output_contract.notes: All activation barriers are at U = -1.15 V (RHE). Selectivity ratios are computed at 300 K using the Arrhenius expression. The DFT code to use is Quantum ESPRESSO, but other open-source plane-wave DFT codes with equivalent accuracy are acceptable as long as the barrier values are within the hidden tolerance.

steps.description: Validate activation barriers against paper gold (±0.2 eV per barrier) and ordering.
Cross-check self-consistency of derived differences/ratios with step_01 barriers, and check recomputed ratios against paper gold within factor 10.
